name: Desire HD

images.credit: Pucky2012, Public domain via Wikimedia Commons

Body.Dimensions: 123 mm L, 68 mm W, 11.8 mm D
Body.Other: FM tuner, Compass, A-GPS, DLNA support, micro-USB, 3.5 mm audio jack, and Wi-Fi tethering

Platform.Operating system: Android 2.2 "Froyo" with HTC Sense, Upgradeable to 2.3.5 "Gingerbread" with HTC Sense 3.0. Newer versions of Android are available through third-party ROMs.

Cameras.Rear camera: 8-megapixel autofocus with dual LED flash and 720p HD video recording.

Connectivity.Connectivity: 2G: 850/900/1800/1900 MHz, 3G: 900/2100 MHz, HSDPA: 14.4 Mbps, HSUPA: 5.76 Mbps, Wi-Fi: 802.11b/g/n, Bluetooth: v2.1 with Enhanced Data Rate
